resources.string: Statistics use the original stored values. The unsmoothed line uses each time bucket’s median. Missing buckets stay empty.
Display smoothing averages up to %1$d consecutive bucket medians. It resets at gaps and does not alter saved readings, statistics or inspection values.
Download timestamps are not stored with these readings. Imported daily totals and live captures use their own time bases; this snapshot does not reconstruct download times.
Live statistics describe the original retained observations, up to 60 seconds. Graph smoothing changes the display only; receipt time is distinct from ring measurement time.
